html:
Rwanda is a small, mountainous country in the Great Lakes region of East Africa. The map shows it from 1815, first as an independent kingdom and later as a colony and republic.

The Kingdom of Rwanda grew from the 1500s. Its king, the mwami, ruled a society of Tutsi, mostly cattle-owning, Hutu, mostly farmers, and the small Twa minority.

Colonial rule made them rigid:

  • Germany claimed Rwanda as part of German East Africa in the 1890s.
  • After the First World War, Belgium ruled it with Burundi as Ruanda-Urundi. It favoured the Tutsi elite and from the 1930s wrote each person's ethnic group on an identity card.

In the Hutu revolution of 1959, Hutu parties overthrew the Tutsi monarchy, and many Tutsi fled abroad. Rwanda became independent in 1962 as a Hutu-led republic.

In 1990 the Rwandan Patriotic Front, formed by Tutsi exiles, invaded from Uganda. In 1994 Hutu extremists organised the genocide of about 800,000 people, mostly Tutsi, in about a hundred days. The RPF took the country and ended the killing. Under Paul Kagame Rwanda has rebuilt fast, under the tight control of his ruling party.
sum: Rwanda is a small, mountainous country in the Great Lakes region of East Africa. The map shows it from 1815, first as an independent kingdom and later as a colony and republic.
